name: qkd_ahub_sdw-a1-COMMIT
purpose: KV-AHUBDW: harden the KV die static attention hub qkd_ahub_static_dw (cluster: 4 Z trees + reciprocal leaf + core logic) to the die slot

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_static_cal_gen.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_ahub_static_dw --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUBDW 10-18): the KV die hub element qkd_ahub_static_dw (static six-root hub) as a cluster of 5 CLOSED children (4 ot_nhb_zh m5 views, ot_qkh_recip_leaf np1 view) + flat core / io logic; the closed qkd_ahub_core belongs to the legacy hub and is not used.  RTL pin rules in 02f980add (flop-first pins, ot_rst_pipe regional resets).
